verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own docs describe an ecosystem of 23,600+ modules and 3,900+ providers that users can consume. They also mention programmatic module version management and configuration you can 'version, reuse, and share', and they address module authors. This supports the consuming side, but nothing in the evidence describes a public registry or a workflow for publishing modules to one. Missing for 10: documented public registry for module consumption (sources/addresses), documented module publishing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of registry use.
